reviewMethod: Automated inspection of exact inputs, parser outputs/errors and extraction reasons; full parser outcomes also compared with Linux CI run 40857303180. Browser findings reviewed in the starter Chrome fixture. This is a diagnostic baseline, not a conformance claim.

reviews.unitless-length: Exact invalid unitless-length inputs reach typed length parsers, often emitting px. Includes lengths in functions and shorthands; preserve these candidates until parser fixes are reviewed.
reviews.empty-animation-name: The invalid empty quoted animation name reaches the typed parser and emits an empty value. Record the exact emission without treating typed acceptance as browser conformance.
reviews.background-clip: The invalid border keyword is accepted and printed by background-clip.
reviews.background-layers: The invalid background value contains a color in more than one layer and is retained by the typed parser.
reviews.color-scheme: The invalid standalone only keyword is retained by the typed color-scheme parser.
reviews.alpha-function: The invalid alpha(from ...) color inputs are evaluated to colors. Record exact emissions pending grammar review.
reviews.color-mix-range: color-mix accepts the pinned invalid negative or over-100% mixing percentages and evaluates them. Exact input/output pairs are retained as validation candidates.
reviews.color-grammar: The pinned invalid legacy color separators/components, none alpha, and relative hue dimensions reach typed color evaluation. Exact outputs need grammar review.
reviews.display-duplicates: Repeated list-item keywords in the pinned invalid display values are deduplicated by parsing.
reviews.easing-constraints: Invalid cubic-bezier x coordinates and steps counts are retained or normalized by typed easing parsers.
reviews.grid-grammar: Pinned invalid grid identifiers, spans, auto-repeat constraints, and adjacent line-name groups are accepted. Exact emissions are diagnostic candidates, not independently confirmed browser regressions.
reviews.image-set: Invalid negative resolutions, none images, and nested image-set inputs reach the typed parser. Snapshot only the listed inputs and emissions.
reviews.math-dimensions: Pinned invalid mixed-dimensional min/max or conic-gradient math is preserved by typed parsing. This does not by itself show a browser behavior change.
reviews.position-grammar: Invalid three/four-component position forms for these properties are accepted and sometimes reordered. Preserve exact emissions until property-specific grammar fixes are reviewed.
reviews.symbols-grammar: Invalid symbols() arity and image arguments are retained by typed list-style parsers.
reviews.mask-box: The pinned invalid mask margin-box value is retained as a typed mask shorthand.
reviews.scroll-margin: Invalid auto/percentage scroll-margin values are retained by typed logical and physical property parsers.
reviews.decoration-grammar: Invalid duplicate or incompatible text-decoration-line keywords are normalized by typed parsing.
reviews.shadow-arity: The four-length text-shadow value is retained by typed parsing although the pinned test expects rejection.
reviews.text-transform-duplicates: Repeated text-transform keywords are deduplicated by parsing.
reviews.transition-identifiers: Invalid none/CSS-wide/default transition identifiers in shorthands or lists reach typed parsing.
reviews.outline-hidden: The pinned invalid hidden outline-style value is retained by typed parsing.
reviews.infinite-hue: Four valid hsl/hwb infinite-hue inputs panic with the same hue-range assertion in every mode. Chrome accepts the originals. Only this exact panic is accepted; crashes and timeouts remain infrastructure errors.
reviews.url-modifiers: The 32 valid background-image URL-modifier inputs are rejected by the parser. A separate Chrome specified-value probe matched 22 known modifiers and rejected 10 unknown modifiers; these are support candidates, not all independently confirmed browser regressions.
reviews.var-syntax: Eight pinned valid width values use newer var() argument forms rejected by both this parser and the tested Chrome. Record the support gap without changing the upstream expectations.
reviews.browser-column-gap: Chrome rejects column-gap:10 but accepts the emitted 10px in each mode. The starter browser oracle reproduces this difference.
reviews.browser-animation: Two unnamed animation items lose duration, delay, timing function and iteration count. The starter fixture reproduces changed computed longhands; optimization policy still needs review.
reviews.external-helper: The listed pages depend on external helper families that the extractor does not adapt. Their exact dependency errors remain explicit coverage gaps.
reviews.selector-rule-helper: The listed pages call selector, rule, keyframes or legacy-alias helpers outside the current property/shorthand adapter.
reviews.browser-setup: The listed pages need DOM, CSS, test(), setup(), or a named element from the original browser fixture. Partial extracted cases are discarded atomically.
reviews.extra-helper-arguments: These two upstream pages pass extra arguments to test_invalid_value. The extractor deliberately rejects unsupported helper signatures and discards the page.
reviews.event-driven-fixtures: These nine scrollbar pages register DOM/layout test assertions from body onload=performTest(). They previously produced no cases because the event lifecycle was never executed. Reviewed each source page; keep them as explicit unsupported event-driven fixtures. No parser cases or CSS failure expectations changed.
